general_information.test_case_name: Poisson on cube strong scaling test, multigrid preconditioner
general_information.test_case_description: Strong scaling of the Poisson model with manufactured solution on 3D cube, solved with multigrid-preconditioned CG.
general_information.simulation_name: Poisson strong scaling on 3D cube, multigrid preconditioner
general_information.simulation_description:
Strong scaling test for Poisson equation on a 3D cube.
The manufactured solution is a Gaussian bump times sin(pi*x/Lx), exciting the full spectrum.
Homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions are set in direction x.
The linear system is solved with CG preconditioned by geometric multigrid.
